mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Company Registration / Certificate of Incorporation of the Taiwanese corporate investor
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Ministry of Economic Affairs, Taiwan (MOEA) - Department of Commercial Affairs
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization route only, because Taiwan is not an Apostille Convention contracting party: Taiwan district court notarization, then Straits Exchange Foundation (SEF) verification, then Association for Relations Across the Taiwan Straits (ARATS) verification, then acceptance by the PRC State Administration for Market Regulation. No Hague Apostille is available for this document and no sequential apostille-consular chain may be used.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Taiwan Company Act, Articles 2, 6, 8-10, 15-18, 128-156, 192 and 418 (incorporation, governance, registration); Act Governing Electronic Payment Institutions, Articles 7, 8, 10-11, 14, 17 and 26-29 (special EMI license and minimum capital); Foreign Investment Act, Article 5; Regulations Governing the Permission of Investment in the Taiwan Area from the Mainland Area, Articles 4 and 8; Central Bank of China (Taiwan) Foreign Exchange Regulations on Inward Remittance
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Department of Commercial Services, Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEA), Taiwan, R.O.C.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Company Registration of a Wholly Foreign-Owned Limited Company (Company Registration Application Form) accompanied by notarized Articles of Incorporation, First Board Resolution and investment permit
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No general minimum paid-in capital applies to a WFOE under the Company Act; however, the EMI license mandates paid-in capital of at least NT$500,000,000 (approximately USD 16.67 million) under Article 10 of the Act Governing Electronic Payment Institutions. Funds must be remitted from abroad into a designated foreign-investment escrow account at an MOF-designated domestic bank, fully paid up and verified by bank certificate before company registration is completed.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: FIRST BOARD RESOLUTION (PRO-FORMA): RESOLVED, that the subscribers adopt the Articles of Incorporation as filed, and that 100,000,000 ordinary shares at NT$10 par value, totaling NT$500,000,000 paid-in capital, be subscribed and fully paid into the foreign-investment escrow account at E.Sun Commercial Bank. RESOLVED, that the registered office be fixed at 12F, No.100, Songren Road, Xinyi District, Taipei, Taiwan, R.O.C., effective as of the incorporation date. RESOLVED, that the incorporation officers-Chairperson, Chief Financial Officer, and Chief Compliance Officer-be appointed with full authority to execute the EMI licensing application before the Financial Supervisory Commission, open operational bank accounts, and effectuate all statutory registrations under the Company Act.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate Name Pre-approval and Business Scope Pre-verification
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: MOEA Department of Commercial Services, Online Name and Business Scope Pre-Query System
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File an online name pre-query application selecting up to five proposed English and Chinese corporate names; mirror the FSC-approved EMI business scope verbatim in the pre-approval form; the name reservation is valid for six months and must be used in the subsequent investment permit application.
required_dossiers: Draft business scope aligned with Act Governing Electronic Payment Institutions
Shareholder identification certificates (for PRC corporate shareholder, notarized business license and Articles of Association)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name or business scope wording is rejected, refile within five working days with alternative names and FSC-aligned scope; no filing fee is refunded; expedited pre-query review is available upon payment of the statutory expedited fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Foreign/Mainland Investment Permit from Investment Commission
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Investment Commission, Ministry of Economic Affairs, Executive Yuan
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the Investment Application under the Foreign Investment Act and, because the ultimate parent is a PRC entity, the special mainland investment application under the Regulations Governing the Permission of Investment in the Taiwan Area from the Mainland Area; provide the capital plan, draft articles, escrow bank instruction and AML/KYC disclosure of ultimate beneficial owners; the approval letter is a precondition for capital remittance and subsequent company registration.
required_dossiers: Audited financial statements of the investing shareholder for the last two years
Power of attorney notarized at the Taiwan Economic and Cultural Office in Hong Kong or designated venue
AML/KYC and ultimate beneficial ownership statement
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Investment Commission issues a query or correction notice, cure deficiencies within 30 days; if the proposed mainland-funded financial service is subject to the negative list restriction, restructure through a Taiwan or third-country intermediate holding entity or obtain a written pre-permission from the FSC; a formal denial may be appealed to the Executive Yuan Administrative Appeals Board.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Escrow Account Opening, Capital Remittance and Verification
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Designated domestic bank (E.Sun Commercial Bank) as escrow agent under Central Bank of China (Taiwan) foreign exchange rules
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a temporary NT$ escrow account in the name of the company to be incorporated; remit the full NT$500,000,000 equivalent from the PRC shareholder, possibly routed through a Hong Kong intermediate; the bank issues a paid-in capital verification certificate referencing the FIA approval number; funds remain frozen until the company registration certificate is issued.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the remittance currency code or beneficiary name is discrepant, issue an amendment instruction through the remitting bank; if the Central Bank flags the transaction for AML review, coordinate with the escrow bank's compliance unit to obtain release; a replacement escrow certificate may be reissued within three business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company Incorporation Registration and Issuance of Registration Certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Department of Commercial Services, Ministry of Economic Affairs
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the incorporation application through the MOEA online company registration portal; attach the notarized Articles of Incorporation, the First Board Resolution, officer appointment consents, registered office lease and the escrow verification certificate; after approval, the MOEA issues the Company Registration Certificate and assigns the Uniform Corporate Identification Number.
required_dossiers: Registered office lease and building owner's written consent
Officer consent letters and identification copies (Chairperson, CFO, Chief Compliance Officer)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registrar queries the name, scope or statutory forms, respond within 15 days by amendment; failure to cure within the period requires a fresh filing with a new processing window; the NT$4,000 registration fee applies because paid-in capital exceeds NT$400 million.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax Registration, Unified Business Number and Municipal Business License
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: National Taxation Bureau (Ministry of Finance) and Taipei City Government Construction Management Office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete profit-seeking enterprise income tax registration and VAT status election within 30 days after incorporation; financial service income will be VAT-exempt after FSC license issuance under Article 8-1 of the Business Tax Act, but interim tax registration is mandatory; obtain the municipal business license confirming the premises are within a permitted office zone.
required_dossiers: Registered office tenancy or title deed
Shareholder register and officer residency declarations
FSC preliminary approval letter, if available
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the tax authority disputes the VAT effective date, file a written application for retroactive classification; if the municipal business license is denied for zoning incompatibility, apply for a use-compatibility certificate or relocate the registered office within 14 days and amend the MOEA registration.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: FSC Special License for Electronic Payment Institution
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the EMI license application under Article 8 of the Act Governing Electronic Payment Institutions covering virtual IBAN issuance and digital wallet reserve management; include the business plan, governance manual, AML/CFT program, internal audit charter, information security policy, reserve settlement arrangements and compliance officer qualifications; the FSC conducts a committee review and an on-site inspection before issuance.
required_dossiers: Three-year business plan and financial projections
Share register evidencing NT$500,000,000 paid-in capital
AML/CFT policy, risk assessment and enforcement procedures
ISO 27001 or equivalent information security management certification
Reserve settlement and clearing arrangements with the Central Bank of China (Taiwan)
Compliance, internal audit and risk management officer appointment documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the FSC identifies deficiency points, submit a corrective brief within the prescribed period, typically 30 days; serious deficiencies may trigger an informal hearing or a request for additional risk-based capital; formal denial may be contested through the FSC Petition Committee appeal process.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Physical Premises, Fire Safety, Building Use and Occupational Clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Taipei City Fire Department; Taipei City Construction Management Office; Ministry of Labor (Occupational Safety and Health Administration); FSC inspection delegate
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete fire safety inspection of the registered office, server room and emergency power room; verify compliance with the Fire Services Act; obtain building use compliance certification for financial office use; conduct the occupational health and safety workplace inspection covering server room environment and emergency lighting; the FSC performs a final on-premises review before license activation.
required_dossiers: Building use permit or change-of-use approval
Occupational health and safety risk assessment report
Server room physical access control and surveillance records
Property and business interruption insurance policies
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If inspection fails, rectify nonconformities within 14 days and apply for reinspection; if the building change-of-use application is denied, relocate the registered office and amend the MOEA registration; a temporary use permit may be requested during structural remediation.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Electronic Payment Institution License issued under the Act Governing Electronic Payment Institutions, with supplementary approval for virtual IBAN issuance and digital wallet reserve management under Article 26 of the same Act

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Environmental Protection Administration (EPA), Taiwan, R.O.C., reconstituted as the Ministry of Environment effective August 22, 2023
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category C - Exempt from full EIA. A leased Grade-A office and data-room premises for fintech back-office operations qualifies for the registration-only procedure; no comprehensive Environmental Impact Assessment Report is required, but a self-declaration of green building compliance and a data center energy efficiency statement must be filed.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Applicable compliance thresholds: (1) domestic wastewater discharged to the public sewerage system must meet pH 5-9 and COD below 100 mg/L under the Water Pollution Control Act schedules; (2) standby diesel generators must satisfy air pollutant limits under the Air Pollution Control Act, including NOx below 250 ppm and opacity below 20%; (3) end-of-life servers, UPS batteries and e-waste must be handled by EPA-licensed waste processors under Article 28 of the Waste Disposal Act.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Management Plan certified under Articles 6 and 13 of the Fire Services Act, including sprinkler, smoke-control and emergency power room inspections; structural load certificate for the server-room floor plating issued by a licensed structural engineer; workplace layout clearance under the Occupational Safety and Health Facilities Rules covering server-room temperature control (18-28 degrees Celsius), cable management, emergency lighting and ergonomic workstation standards; final physical security and business premises inspection by the FSC under the Enforcement Rules of the Act Governing Electronic Payment Institutions.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: State Administration of Taxation (SAT), People's Republic of China
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Foreign-invested enterprises register with local SAT branch within 30 days of establishment using business license, articles of association, capital verification report and legal representative ID; obtain Unified Social Credit Code and Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN)
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box election available; hybrid mismatch rules apply under OECD BEPS framework

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory real-time electronic invoicing via National Tax Information Network (NTIN); digital VAT stamps required; API integration with SAT for invoice clearance and reporting

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: 0% VAT on exported goods and offshore services to non-residents provided export proof and goods/services not consumed domestically
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Retrospective audits possible; penalties up to five times evaded tax amount plus criminal liability for fraudulent claims

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: The People's Bank of China (PBOC) is the supreme monetary and payment-system authority; the State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE) is the designated foreign-exchange regulator and clearing-rail supervisor. PBOC licenses and supervises non-bank payment institutions, including electronic-money operators, under the Regulations on the Supervision and Administration of Non-bank Payment Institutions (State Council Order No. 768, effective 1 May 2024). SAFE administers the onshore FX account and reporting systems, the CNAPS clearing architecture (HVPS/BEPS), and the Cross-Border Interbank Payment System (CIPS) for RMB international settlement.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: RMB is fully convertible for current-account items, including trade, services, and dividend remittance, subject to authenticity verification by designated banks under the Foreign Exchange Administration Regulations (2008 Order of the State Council). The capital account remains managed: FDI equity injections require a SAFE FDI Base Registration and conversion to RMB is permitted only on a payment-based settlement basis with a statutory negative list; external debt requires a SAFE Foreign-Debt Registration and cross-border guarantees must be reported. Profit remittance hurdles are substantive: dividends may be paid only from after-CIT retained earnings supported by the annual statutory audit report, a unanimous shareholder resolution, a tax-clearance certificate confirming payment of the 10% dividend withholding tax (or the reduced treaty rate under the Cross-Strait Double Taxation Arrangement, where the Limitation-on-Benefits conditions are met), and the bank's verification of the SAFE non-trade payment purpose code for return of investment. The remitting bank will also complete a money-laundering risk assessment of the beneficial owner and may require a Taiwan-side Investment Commission approval record for the original inbound investment.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: China abolished the export-collection verification and surrender system in 2012; there is currently no mandatory conversion ratio and no statutory obligation to surrender export proceeds to the central bank. Exporters may retain foreign currency in a domestic foreign-currency account or use the voluntary settlement facility. Receipts must be repatriated into China within the contractual credit term; for goods trade, any receivable beyond 90 days from customs clearance must be reported as a deferred receipt through the Goods Trade Foreign Exchange Monitoring System within 30 days of the customs declaration. A-class enterprises enjoy streamlined bank processing, but B/C-class enterprises are subject to restricted payment terms and enhanced document checks. Material mismatches in excess of 15% between the declared invoice value and customs/export data require a written explanation, a revised declaration, and supporting contracts.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility Rating: LOW-MEDIUM. Legal constraints: (1) An offshore foreign EMI license does not confer any right to open virtual IBANs or hold digital-wallet reserves for Chinese residents; any payment activity in China requires a PBOC Payment Business License under State Council Order No. 768, and the WFOE must satisfy the minimum paid-in registered capital requirement (RMB 100 million for nationwide payment services, or the provincial-tier amount determined by PBOC). (2) SEPA_Credit is not directly reachable from within China; the WFOE must clear EUR payments through a correspondent bank or a Chinese bank's European branch, and any client-facing virtual IBAN product is permissible only as a bank-issued sub-account arrangement, not as a standalone EMI rail. (3) The Personal Information Protection Law and PBOC fintech data rules require a security assessment and local data localization before transferring client transaction data cross-border; offshore data processing by the Taiwanese parent is a material compliance risk. (4) Client funds must be segregated in a dedicated custody/reserve account with a qualified Chinese commercial bank; no offshore third-party holding of Chinese client float is permitted.

physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand.physical_and_remote_rules: Physical presence is the strict default for a WFOE classified as High-Risk Special License. The legal representative, or a deputy holding a notarized and consular-legalized power of attorney, must attend an in-person KYC interview at the bank's corporate branch. Bank AML officers are also required to conduct a site inspection of the registered business address and verify the company seal, board resolutions, and the original certificate of incorporation. Remote video account opening is permitted only under PBOC digitalization pilots and is generally not extended to foreign-invested payment companies; therefore, the treasury plan must assume a physical director visit plus a physical office inspection.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Underwriting red flag: the immediate shareholder is a Taiwanese technology holding company with no mainland operating history, triggering enhanced beneficial-ownership review and source-of-wealth inquiries.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: SAFE FDI Base Registration Certificate; notarized and legalized Certificate of Incorporation and Certificate of Good Standing of the Taiwanese parent; the Taiwan Investment Commission approval for the mainland investment; group organizational chart; board resolution appointing the WFOE legal representative; three years of audited group financial statements; WFOE lease agreement for the physical office; and local employment contracts for at least one senior compliance manager and one local finance officer.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Underwriting red flag: large incoming client float and e-money reserve balances without a corresponding goods- or services-trade reconciliation, potentially indicating unlicensed deposit-taking.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: PBOC Payment Business License, or the official PBOC acceptance notice of the license application; the client-fund custody agreement executed with a qualified depository bank; a written explanation of the e-money float segregation methodology; the bank-issued escrow account confirmation; a FATF-style AML self-assessment; and compliance policies showing that float is never lent or invested outside the permitted reserve assets.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Underwriting red flag: high-velocity cross-border low-value transactions with rapid in-and-out flows, a classic money-laundering and terror-financing typology for e-money platforms.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: The WFOE AML Compliance Program adopted pursuant to PBOC AML rules; designation of a qualified AML compliance officer; transaction threshold and monitoring policies, including enhanced due diligence for transactions above RMB 50,000 or EUR 5,000 equivalent; proof of connectivity to the China Anti-Money Laundering Monitoring and Analysis Center reporting channel; and a signed undertaking to file suspicious-transaction reports within five business days.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Underwriting red flag: the initial paid-in capital injection from Taiwan cannot be linked to a verifiable underlying corporate treasury or financial capacity.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: SWIFT MT103 remittance instruction from the Taiwanese remitting bank; capital contribution board resolution of the Taiwanese parent; paid-in-capital verification report issued by a Chinese certified public accountant; the Taiwanese parent's income tax filing and audited balance sheet for the previous fiscal year; and a source-of-wealth letter executed by the ultimate beneficial owner, supported by bank statements covering the preceding 12 months.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: The compliant routing sequence is: (1) complete the TW-side Investment Commission approval under the Taiwan-Mainland relations statute, and the PRC-side MOFCOM foreign-investment information filing for the Taiwanese investor; (2) obtain the SAFE FDI Base Registration certificate for the WFOE; (3) open a Foreign-Currency Capital Account and a RMB Basic Deposit Account at the designated tier-1 bank; (4) receive the inward remittance via SWIFT MT103 using the SAFE payment purpose code for FDI paid-in capital, with field 70 specifying the WFOE name, the SAFE FDI registration code, and the reference '/INV/CN_WFOE_LTD'; (5) the receiving bank reports the credit in the SAFE Foreign Exchange Account System within T+1; and (6) each conversion from the capital account to RMB is executed on a payment-based settlement basis, requiring the bank to verify underlying transaction documents against the negative list, which prohibits use for domestic equity investment not within business scope, securities, real estate beyond self-use, and entrusted loans. The entire flow requires the receiving bank to retain the original capital verification report and the board capital-contribution resolution for the account file.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For outbound settlement, the WFOE may use: (1) SWIFT MT103/202 for direct USD, EUR, or HKD disbursements from the foreign-currency operational account for goods and services, with the bank retaining invoice, contract, and customs/service proof; (2) an irrevocable at-sight Commercial Letter of Credit issued by the Chinese commercial bank under UCP600 for high-value goods transactions, including document checking against the bill of lading and commercial invoice; (3) CIPS for RMB-denominated outbound payments, including those ultimately reaching a SEPA beneficiary via the Chinese bank's European branch or a euro-correspondent bank holding an IBAN; and (4) SAFE-converted RMB from the capital account, subject to the same negative-list verification. Each outbound payment must carry the appropriate SAFE payment purpose code and the bank must file the transaction in the SAFE monitoring system; timely but not formulaic documentation is required for annual inspection and anti-avoidance review.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Customer FX Forward contracts (settlement-date matched to a verified underlying trade or operating cash-flow), executed under the real-demand principle with a SAFE-approved designated bank.
FX Swaps between CNY and USD/EUR for short-term liquidity rollover, with SAFE position and maturity reporting.
Cross-Currency Interest Rate Swaps to hedge cash-flow mismatch on a SAFE-registered external debt facility, with the underlying loan and the swap registered and documented.

RMB FX Options (purchase of call or put options paid in CNY) with the premium and strike aligned to a genuine exposure; sale or combination strategies are permitted only as covered hedging of an established position.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Taiwan corporate income tax annual return
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: National Taxation Bureau, Ministry of Finance
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: By 31 May following the fiscal year-end for a calendar-year company
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Tax surcharge and administrative fine for late or non-filing; assessment and collection enforcement may follow. No routine corporate strike-off is triggered solely by late tax filing.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual financial statements and regulatory report of an electronic payment institution
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Financial Supervisory Commission and Central Bank of the Republic of China (Taiwan), as applicable
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within the statutory period prescribed for annual financial reporting, generally within four months after fiscal year-end; confirm the institution's license-specific reporting rule
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fines, corrective orders, restrictions on business, responsible-person sanctions, and potential license suspension or revocation for material or repeated breaches.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual shareholders' meeting and approval of financial statements
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Company shareholders; filings are maintained through the Ministry of Economic Affairs registration system only when a registrable change occurs
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within six months after fiscal year-end, unless a lawful extension applies
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Responsible officers may incur statutory fines and shareholder or regulatory remedies. Failure to hold the meeting does not normally create an automatic annual strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Department of Commerce, Ministry of Economic Affairs, Taiwan
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Taiwan does not generally require a standalone annual return for a limited company; report registered particulars within the statutory change-filing period, generally 15 days after the change
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fines for late change registration and possible compulsory correction. Persistent non-compliance may support dissolution or revocation proceedings under the Company Act; there is no routine annual strike-off deadline.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Withholding tax annual reconciliation and information reporting
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: National Taxation Bureau, Ministry of Finance
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Generally by 31 January for withholding statements and by 10 February for annual withholding declarations, subject to the applicable tax year rules
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing penalties, withholding-tax assessments, interest, and liability of the withholding agent for unpaid or incorrectly withheld tax.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: National Taxation Bureau, Ministry of Finance
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual reconciliation is generally incorporated into the applicable business tax filings; monthly business tax returns are ordinarily due by the 15th day of the following month
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing penalties, tax assessment, interest, and possible suspension or other sanctions for serious or repeated non-compliance.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A licensed electronic payment institution is subject to regulatory financial-reporting and independent CPA audit requirements under its governing license regime. Taiwan company and tax rules may independently require CPA certification based on regulated status, public-company status, paid-in capital, revenue, employee-count, or other prescribed thresholds. The exact threshold must be confirmed with the Financial Supervisory Commission and the National Taxation Bureau before licensing.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Taiwan-IFRS as endorsed by the Financial Supervisory Commission for regulated financial institutions, supplemented by Taiwan company, tax, and electronic-payment regulatory rules. The entity's license conditions control where sector-specific requirements apply.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Taiwan does not generally impose a standalone annual UBO confirmation for every company. Report prescribed changes in directors, managers, significant shareholders, and beneficial ownership information within the applicable statutory period, generally 15 days after the change. The electronic payment institution must maintain current customer and ownership information and complete risk-based periodic KYC and AML reviews.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Minutes of shareholders' meetings and board meetings
Accounting books, financial statements, and supporting accounting documents
Beneficial ownership and AML governance records

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 800-3,000 per year, excluding premises, nominee, licensing, AML officer, and regulatory consulting costs
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 15,000-60,000 per year for a licensed electronic payment institution, depending on transaction volume, safeguarding arrangements, group reporting, internal controls, and regulatory complexity

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Taiwan levies a 20% profit-seeking enterprise income tax (營利事業所得稅) on taxable income; annual taxable income below NT$120,000 is exempt, and taxable income between NT$120,000 and NT$200,000 enjoys a progressive-phase-in concession. Additional incentives: 1) R&D investment tax credit of up to 10% of qualifying R&D expenditures under Article 10 of the Statute for Industrial Innovation (產業創新條例), capped at 30% of corporate income tax payable; 2) 5% retained-earnings surtax (未分配盈餘加徵) applies on undistributed earnings, effectively pushing distributed profits to a lower combined burden when repatriated; 3) no special CIT holiday applies to fintech or electronic-money institutions, and the 12% Alternative Minimum Tax (所得基本稅額) applies to preferentially treated or lightly taxed income where the regular tax falls below the AMT floor.
